name: sk-prompt-suggestions
title: Prompt Suggestions
description: The starter prompts on an empty assistant screen. They arrive on a 45ms stagger — slow enough to read as sequence, fast enough that nobody waits. Wrapped by default via a custom flow layout, because a horizontal rail hides the fourth suggestion off screen and a suggestion nobody sees does no work.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKPromptSuggestions(["Summarise this thread", "Draft a reply"]) { send($0) }
SKPromptSuggestions(prompts, layout: .rail, onSelect: send)
